response.sql: WITH rating_counts AS (SELECT f.rating, COUNT(*) AS films_in_stock FROM inventory AS i JOIN film AS f ON f.film_id = i.film_id GROUP BY f.rating), rating_average AS (SELECT AVG(films_in_stock) AS avg_films_in_stock FROM rating_counts) SELECT SUM(rc.films_in_stock) AS total_films_in_stock, AVG(rc.films_in_stock - ra.avg_films_in_stock) AS avg_above_rating_average FROM rating_counts AS rc CROSS JOIN rating_average AS ra WHERE rc.films_in_stock > ra.avg_films_in_stock

assumptions.assumption: Each inventory row counts as one film copy in stock.
